subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw support non-USD configured model-cost semantics, and if yes should currency live per model, per provider, globally, or only as a display preference?
rationale: The request touches a high-bar config surface plus stored/session cost names, `/usage`, `/status`, Control UI aggregation, docs, and USD telemetry, so automation should not choose the accounting contract.

options.title: Define the currency contract first
options.body: Choose the scope and accounting/display semantics before implementation so mixed-provider totals and existing USD fields remain honest.

options.title: Keep configured model costs USD-only
options.body: Leave the current contract intact and treat non-USD provider price tables as unsupported until maintainers want a larger accounting change.

options.title: Add display-only formatting
options.body: Allow a narrow symbol or ISO-code preference while explicitly preserving USD-like stored totals and documenting the ambiguity.

recommendation.title: Define the currency contract first
recommendation.body: Choose the scope and accounting/display semantics before implementation so mixed-provider totals and existing USD fields remain honest.

likelyOwner.reason: The original usage-cost reporting and product-surface impact make this the strongest available routing candidate for the currency contract choice.
